//: Season -> period-correct head gear.
Equipment lives in the save's CharacterVisuals table, not the Player
table. Each entry names a helmet and the face mask moulded to fit it;
the two are always written together, because a mask belongs to a shell.
BRAND CARRIES OVER, THE MODEL CHANGES. A player's current helmet names a
manufacturer, and they move to that manufacturer's model for the era --
Riddell to Riddell, Schutt to Schutt. That keeps a squad looking mixed,
the way real ones were. Brands that did not exist yet (Vicis shipped
nothing until 2016, Light little earlier) have no same-brand model to
move to, so those players take the era's fallback.
Every asset name here has been confirmed to exist in the game by making
the change in the community roster editor and diffing the export. A
season not covered by an era leaves equipment untouched -- an invented
asset name would be a guess with a broken helmet at the end of it.
To add one: make the change in the editor for one player, export, and
read the helmet and face mask names out of the diff. No code change.
The Riddell Revolution is confirmed; Schutt's 2000s shells (Air
Advantage, DNA) have not been demonstrated yet, so a Schutt wearer
in this era falls back to the Revolution. Add a 'Schutt' entry here
once one has been confirmed in the editor.
